summary: Click a cell to place a prefab snapped to the grid, with a hover highlight.
overview: Click or tap a cell and the assigned prefab is placed there, snapped to the grid, with a highlight following the cursor. Assign a GridComponent and it works immediately; it raycasts a ground plane, so that plane needs to be on the mask layers.
useCases: Placing towers, buildings or walls on a playfield.
A level editor where the designer clicks to paint props.
Any build mode that needs snapping without a bespoke input path.

params.tuning: Must include the layer of the ground collider under the grid. If nothing places, this is almost always why.
Leave empty to use Camera.main, which is fine until a scene has more than one camera.
Turns a second click into a delete, which is usually what a build mode wants.

gotchas.title: 3D ground-plane raycasting only
gotchas.body: It targets an XZ ground plane. A 2D (XY) setup needs a different raycast path.

gotchas.title: It needs a collider to hit
gotchas.body: The grid gizmo is not a surface. Without a plane or terrain collider beneath it, every click misses.
